content.text: Build passes. Let me confirm the full test scope covers the holiday behavior.

The change is complete and the test suite is green.

## What I did

The business-day roll in `BusinessDay.java` previously only skipped weekends (Sat/Sun → next Monday). I extended it to also skip the fixed public-holiday list, rolling forward one day at a time until it lands on a non-weekend, non-holiday date:

- Added the holiday set (`2026-01-01`, `2026-01-26`, `2026-04-25`, `2026-12-25`, `2026-12-28`).
- Replaced the single-step weekend logic with a loop, so it correctly handles runs of consecutive non-business days — e.g. Fri `2026-12-25` (holiday) → Sat/Sun weekend → Mon `2026-12-28` (holiday) → lands on Tue `2026-12-29`.

This matches the test oracle in `AcceptanceBase.toBusinessDay` (same holiday set, same iterative roll), and both callers — `BuildOwner` (registration date) and `CheckOwnerDailyLimit` (daily-limit count) — pick up the adjusted date automatically since they both go through `BusinessDay.roll`.

`mvnw -o test` → **BUILD SUCCESS**, `Tests run: 1, Failures: 0, Errors: 0`.
